metadataRaw.title: Elbow Pain Relief in Seconds #Shorts
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows the elbow hammer stretch, which can give quick elbow pain relief. 

This exercise is especially good for tennis elbow (lateral epicondylitis) and golfer's elbow (medial epicondylitis). 

It can also be used as a daily exercise to help lengthen and strengthen the muscles and soft tissues that support the elbow, giving long lasting relief.

Let us know how it works for you!
